answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed for proven fake attestations: creating one identity is cheap, but spinning up thousands means locking capital per identity and risking its loss, so a Sybil farm pays linearly while honest agents pay once. Reputation then grows only from attested work over time, not from self-declared claims. An attacker chasing a quick oasis of free rewards finds the opposite: at its nadir, after slashing and lockups, the farm holds worthless identities, unlike a fable where copies multiply for free.
